name: hellboy-prod
description: A terminal agent bridge for a running music production session.

scripts.build: npm run build -w mock-live && npm run build -w bridge && npm run build -w installer && npm run build -w app
scripts.test: npm run build -w mock-live && npm run build -w bridge && npm run build -w app && node --test bridge/dist/test/roundtrip.test.js app/test/app.test.js app/test/cli.test.js
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle -w bridge && npm run bundle -w installer && npm run bundle -w app
scripts.studio: npm run bundle -w app && node app/build/app.cjs
